My first bot ever, but I've been an avid user for a while, so I wanted to give it a go! I loosely based this one off a cute little reddit story I heard while watching smosh pit.

Don't expect too much though. Also make sure to alert me of any mistakes I've made in the discussion so I can fix them pronto. :P
